designationHistory.indexText: Chassahowitzka NWR was established in 1943 for waterfowl conservation.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Chassahowitzka National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

review.note: Sources disagree: the Crystal River/Chassahowitzka CCP says the refuge "was established on December 29, 1941, with the acquisition of 2,742 acres" and elsewhere "in 1943." Settle from the MBCC record or FWS 1941-43 news releases.
